A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CrossFlow by the same authors. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and support reliable matching across the revision.

before.justification: v1 reports original CrossFlow experiments on text-to-image generation, captioning, depth estimation, and super-resolution, together with ablations and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds results for sin-cos matching, inversion-based captioning, and quantitative latent arithmetic.

M1.justification: v2 adds a CrossFlow variant using sin-cos rather than linear matching (Section 5.1.2), and captioning by fine-tuning and inverting the text-to-image model (Section 5.3). These extend the existing procedure; the core variational encoder, joint objective, and guidance indicator remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The training datasets, benchmarks, and task coverage are retained, including the appendix's zero-shot depth datasets. The new arithmetic evaluation uses COCO-val within the existing latent-editing task, and inversion is evaluated on the existing COCO captioning task.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 4 expand the internal method comparisons with CrossFlow (Sin-Cos) and CrossFlow-T2I, respectively, alongside the original CrossFlow methods. The external baseline sets remain unchanged, including those in the appendix.

E3.justification: v2 adds a detector-based arithmetic evaluation using 1,000 COCO-val prompts and a scaling-factor sweep from 0.25 to 3. It also adds the COCO fine-tuning and inversion experiment. Existing splits and training budgets are retained; the newly mentioned logit-normal timestep sampling is a disclosure, without evidence of a changed setting.

E4.justification: New Appendix B.2 supplements the existing arithmetic examples with a scaling sensitivity analysis and measured success rates for addition, subtraction, and combined operations. The earlier encoder, guidance, language-model, training-strategy, and zero-shot depth analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for these experiments. The new arithmetic percentages add results without introducing uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Table 2 retains CrossFlow's 9.63 FID and 0.55 GenEval, adding 8.95 and 0.57 for the distinct sin-cos variant. Table 4 adds inversion-based captioning with 33.1 BLEU@4 and 111.2 CIDEr, while retaining the original 36.4 and 116.2. New Table 8 reports arithmetic success rates of 95.3%, 92.7%, and 87.5%, with 91.4% overall. Existing result rows and scaling trends remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and Equations 1–8 are retained, including the appendix's loss definitions. Sin-cos matching is cited and described as a variant, without adding a formal derivation, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: The introduction adds an explicit claim that CrossFlow supports bidirectional reuse, including inversion of a text-to-image model for captioning. The main claims about direct cross-modal generation, scaling, and latent arithmetic remain. The title's added 'Noise-Free' restates an existing claim.

C2.justification: Appendix B.2 adds a word2vec analogy explaining emergent latent arithmetic and interprets successful detector-checked edits as evidence of feature disentanglement. Existing scaling explanations and applicability qualifications are retained; no substantive new limitations discussion appears.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 newly specifies logit-normal sampling of training timesteps. The KL weight of 1e-4 is repeated in the main text but was already documented in v1 Appendix A.1. Existing hardware, training-budget, and project-access information is retained; the new arithmetic detector remains unidentified.

R1.justification: v2 adds references on stochastic interpolants, data-dependent coupling, word2vec, Shifted Diffusion, and two 3D-generation works. These modestly extend the research context without substantially changing CrossFlow's positioning. Consolidating duplicate preprint/publication entries does not remove a distinct prior work.

P1.justification: The title changes, several related-work, guidance, and experimental paragraphs are tightened or clarified, and Appendix B.2 is inserted with updated cross-references. The main section sequence and overall narrative structure remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the arithmetic scaling illustration in Figure 6 and success-rate Table 8, and expands Tables 2 and 4 with new rows. Figure 3's sizing and spacing change while its data remain. Appendix displays are relocated and renumbered, including the retained guidance figure moving to its own page; existing image examples are preserved.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens the earlier qualitative arithmetic evidence with a 1,000-prompt evaluation and scaling analysis, and supplies experimental support for model reuse through inversion. It also improves training disclosure while retaining the original evidence. The unidentified detector and limited details for the new variants and fine-tuning procedure constrain reproducibility, so the overall gain is useful but limited.
